settings.repere: Texte · Do I need to take a hearing test before
settings.text: Do I need to take a hearing test before buying?

settings.repere: Texte · Our hearing aids are developed to work f
settings.text: Our hearing aids are developed to work for Americans that suffer from mild to moderate hearing loss. With our volume controls and different sized ear domes included with your order, you can rest assured that your Nebroo PRO 2.0 Hearing Aids will fit comfortably, and give you the results you need, without having to see an audiologist or take a hearing test.

settings.repere: Texte · Do I need a prescription before purchasi
settings.text: Do I need a prescription before purchasing?

settings.repere: Texte · No. There is no prescription needed for
settings.text: No. There is no prescription needed for purchasing the Nebroo PRO 2.0 Hearing Aids. Anyone with perceived mild to moderate hearing loss can order them, as long as they are at least 18 years old.

settings.repere: Texte · What if it doesn't work for me?
settings.text: What if it doesn't work for me?

settings.repere: Texte · Our device comes with a 120-Day Money Ba
settings.text: Our device comes with a 120-Day Money Back Guarantee . We're incredibly confident that our device is going to improve your mild to moderate hearing loss issues, but if they don't, please contact info@nebroo.com within 120 days of receiving the product and we will issue you a refund.

settings.repere: Texte · Are Nebroo PRO 2.0 Hearing Aids Visible?
settings.text: Are Nebroo PRO 2.0 Hearing Aids Visible?

settings.repere: Texte · No. Our Nebroo PRO 2.0 Hearing Aids are
settings.text: No. Our Nebroo PRO 2.0 Hearing Aids are a CIC model (Completely-In-Canal) and they are nearly invisible.

settings.text: How long will Shipping take?

settings.repere: Texte · Our warehouse ships out orders within 1
settings.text: Our warehouse ships out orders within 1 business day from when the order is placed. For the shipping It can take anywhere from 7 to 12 business days for the order to arrive.

settings.text: Will they fall out of my ears?

settings.repere: Texte · No! Our hearing aids fit snugly into you
settings.text: No! Our hearing aids fit snugly into your ears, meaning they'll comfortably stay in place all day long.

settings.text: But what if they still don't fit? In that case, you're covered by our 120-Day Money-Back Guarantee.

settings.repere: Texte · Do you offer a warranty?
settings.text: Do you offer a warranty?

settings.repere: Texte · On top of our 120-Day Money-Back Guarant
settings.text: On top of our 120-Day Money-Back Guarantee , we include a FREE 1 Year Warranty on all orders. Even though our hearing aids are made to last for years, we want our customers to have the best experience possible and feel safe when they purchase from us. This means that If your hearing aid breaks or encounters any issues due to a manufacturing defect within one year from the date of purchase, we’ve got you covered.

settings.repere: Texte · If your product gets damaged within 1 ye
settings.text: If your product gets damaged within 1 year of placing your order, simply reach out to info@nebroo.com and we will send you a replacement.

settings.text: What’s the size and dimension of these hearing aids?

settings.text: Great question! They're 0.79 inches long by 0.51 inches wide, making them one of the smallest hearing aids available. You'll also get 10 different sizes of ear domes with your order to make sure our hearing aids fit you perfectly, even with a small or large ear canal!
